display.question: Find fitness creators in the UK under 20k followers who post walking or step-challenge content.

answer.text: This niche is findable on TikTok: several UK-based creators well under the follower limit you set post walking and step-challenge content.
answer.label: fact

answer.text: Others fit as UK walking-adjacent: a wellness creator sharing tips to hit a daily step goal, a lifestyle creator whose routine includes daily steps, a fitness coach posting hike vlogs, and a creator dedicated to beginner-friendly UK hikes.
answer.label: fact

answer.text: A couple of promising larger walking/step accounts were left out for being over the follower limit.
answer.label: limit

answer.text: Note the video-region check proves where the video was posted, not where the creator lives.
answer.label: limit
